10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

1683|c2467ddc.name: Warg Deepwater
1683|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1684|820221cb.name: Khara Deepwater
1684|820221cb.text: There's never an end to the chores around here.

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

5149|837f02f9.name: Brandur Ironhammer
5149|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5157|299c1bec.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|299c1bec.text: Who are you? What do you want from me?

9099|07b284ab.name: Sraaz
9099|07b284ab.text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.

2038-accept.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-accept.text:
As if crashing into the Loch wasn't bad enough, troggs from the nearby island attacked me and stole my tools and special Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives. With no gyrocopter and no explosives, the movement has no chance!

Get my tools back and find my Blastencapper explosives, $N. For Gnomeregan!
2038-accept.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2038-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2038-complete.text: You've done the movement a great service, $N. The troggs and leper gnomes infesting Gnomeregan will soon feel the brunt of a gnomish air assault!
2038-complete.title: Bingles' Missing Supplies

2039-complete.name: Bingles Blastenheimer
2039-complete.text:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
2039-complete.title: Find Bingles

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

256-accept.name: Unknown
256-accept.text:
By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:

Chok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.

Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.

Chok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.
256-accept.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

257-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-accept.text:
Think you can match wits with Daryl the Bold, huh? I should think not! Of course, you're more than welcome to try. Here's a challenge that should prove to be above your abilities, so don't feel too bad if you can't face up to it.

A flock of buzzards has nested here in Loch Modan. Why don't you try to take down some of the beasts? Tell you what, if you meet my challenge in fifteen minutes, I'll give you my bow or gun.

<He looks you over dismissively.>

It seems you haven't much to lose, anyways.
257-accept.title: A Hunter's Boast

257-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
257-complete.text:
What? Success?

Take it from me, Kahzama, you don't let it get to your head. I mean, any unshaven boy with a bow could have killed such... small specimens. And I hope you don't enjoy killing the buzzards so much, yes? We wouldn't want them to become extinct. 

Well, err... Never let it be said that Daryl the Bold would not hold to his word.
257-complete.title: A Hunter's Boast

258-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-accept.text:
Kahzath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.

You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.

Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!

Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
258-accept.title: A Hunter's Challenge

258-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
258-complete.text:
You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.

Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?

What bet?
258-complete.title: A Hunter's Challenge

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

271-accept.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
271-accept.text:
I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.

A year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.

Kill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.

The bear, Ol' Sooty, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
271-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

271-complete.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-complete.text:
Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.

<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>

Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...

<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>

Oh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
271-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

297-accept.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-accept.text:
Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols.  But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins!  And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs.  It makes them go berserk!

Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands!  You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
297-accept.title: Gathering Idols

297-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-complete.text:
You got them!  Nicely done, $N!

And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about.  I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
297-complete.title: Gathering Idols

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-accept.name: Prospector Ironband
298-accept.text:
I need a progress report sent to Thelsamar - a progress report, and a restatement of my request for more blastpowder!  Here's the report.  Take it to Jern Hornhelm.  He's our local contact in Thelsamar.

It's not a difficult task, but it must be done.
298-accept.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-complete.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-complete.text:
Bah!  Ironband's having trouble with the Troggs.  I wonder if he wants that blastpowder to aid his digging, or to aid his efforts against the Trogg beasts...

Well, either way it's powder well spent!

But what's strange is, I sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago.  I wonder where it went...
298-complete.title: Excavation Progress Report

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

301-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
301-accept.text:
We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

Here's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.

You'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
301-accept.title: Report to Ironforge

301-complete.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-complete.text:
Curse that Ironband!  I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
301-complete.title: Report to Ironforge

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

302-accept.name: Prospector Stormpike
302-accept.text:
If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it!  I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.  He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination.  The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
302-accept.title: Powder to Ironband

385-accept.name: Marek Ironheart
385-accept.text:
Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat.

We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts.

Why, this one time...
385-accept.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-complete.name: Marek Ironheart
385-complete.text: Well now, these are excellent specimens you collected, $N. Good money for high quality materials, that's for sure.
385-complete.title: Crocolisk Hunting

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

436-complete.name: Magmar Fellhew
436-complete.text:
Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?

Ironband is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:

It's the Troggs!!
436-complete.title: Ironband's Excavation

468-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
468-accept.text:
Mountaineer Rockgar is looking for volunteers for a mission through Dun Algaz and into the Wetlands.  

If you want to get your boots wet in that soggy county to the north, then speak with Rockgar at Dun Algaz.  Dun Algaz is north up the road, beyond the guard tower.
468-accept.title: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar

531-accept.name: Daryl the Youngling
531-accept.text:
Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!

Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
531-accept.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-complete.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-complete.text: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, $N. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
531-complete.title: Vyrin's Revenge

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
531-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

86613-accept.name: Unknown
86613-accept.text: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613-accept.title: Excavation Tools

86613-complete.name: Prospector Ironband
86613-complete.text:
Our tools!

When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
86613-complete.title: Excavation Tools

86613-progress.name: Prospector Ironband
86613-progress.text: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
86613-progress.title: Excavation Tools

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves
